arc: network: more graceful error handling. This patch changes arc-networkd child to exit more gracefully when some environment conditions force it to exit (no ARC container, no parent...) Previously arc-networkd would fail an assert, which causes noise in the logs and can hide root causes of the problem. More specifically three asserts / LOG(FATAL) are changed: - When arc-networkd child is started, if it fails its setsid call it just exit. This can happen if the parent has already exited due to the environment being not right. - When the container fails to start in time, arc-netword child logs an error and quit. - When arc-networkd child receives an invalid protobuf message, it logs an error and continue looping. This makes it more robust against external malicious messages as well. In addition arc-networkd manager parent process will now gracefully exit if its child exits.
